tasks.short: Interpret protocols and advise treating physicians

steps.what: Interpret protocols and advise physicians on dosage modifications or treatment calculations

tasks.design: Keep protocol interpretation and advice human using {DOCS} and {OTHER} clinical records. The treating physician retains prescribing and treatment decisions; no autonomous dosage recommendation is introduced.
tasks.previous_blocker: Patient characteristics and exceptions require interpretation before a calculation is meaningful.
tasks.enabler_now: Existing protocol references and approved calculation aids support the work; no new automation is proposed.
tasks.still_hard: Resolve conflicting evidence and know when the protocol does not clearly cover the case.
tasks.human_edge: Recognise a clinically important exception and involve the responsible physician.
tasks.altitude: Advisory duties and physician authority remain unchanged.

reach.learn: Clinical evidence and delegated advice limits

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: protocol interpretation and patient-specific advice are distinct from arithmetic execution; no separate removable calculation baseline is established.

assumptions: Boundary is coordinator advice within qualifications, excluding diagnosis, prescribing and administering treatment. {OTHER} means clinical records system.

The responsible clinician supplies patient evidence and the current clinical question before advice; the coordinator verifies protocol revision, relevant characteristics, units, timing and uncertainty within s1. Missing data returns to clinician clarification. No free dose-adjustment or patient-suitability flag is assumed.
Test native approved calculation aids before custom tools; no new calculation system is proposed and existing runtime earns no labour saving.
Incremental upkeep is zero because the existing advice process and tools remain unchanged.
unknowns: Coordinator qualifications and approved protocol calculation aids
research_questions: Is repetitive arithmetic separable from patient-specific interpretation and already automated?

already_counted.description: Clinical source verification, protocol interpretation and physician discussion

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B=100, R=100, incremental=0; net=0. Clear protocol cases and uncertain modifications retain interpretation and physician discussion; no prescribing time is removed.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Confirm study equipment and software specifications with suppliers

steps.what: Contact industry representatives and clarify equipment and software specifications for the study

tasks.design: Keep specification clarification with the coordinator, using {EMAIL} and {DOCS} for the existing exchange. No supplier assertion is converted automatically into a study compatibility decision.
tasks.previous_blocker: Specifications must be understood against the study's actual use and constraints.
tasks.enabler_now: Existing supplier communication supports clarification; no new automation is proposed.
tasks.still_hard: Identify omissions and get a precise answer about the required configuration.
tasks.human_edge: Ask the question that exposes an unsupported compatibility claim.
tasks.altitude: Supplier communication duties and technical acceptance authority remain unchanged.

reach.learn: Study requirements and evidence of compatibility

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: supplier specification discussions involve contextual clarification; no generic administrative saving is established.

assumptions: Boundary is clarification and reporting, excluding procurement commitment, technical acceptance and installation.

The investigator supplies study requirements before contact. Representatives produce configuration details and supporting evidence during s1 before clarification is complete; coordinator capture, comparison and follow-up remain in its full time. No free study-compatible flag is assumed.
The coordinator confirms permitted disclosure and recipient before contact; unresolved technical claims return to the responsible specialist.
Test native document access before custom tooling. Incremental upkeep is zero because current communication is unchanged; supplier work is not increased.
unknowns: Required systems and technical acceptance owner
research_questions: Is repeated specification table copying distinct from the supplier conversation?

already_counted.description: Disclosure checks, supplier dialogue and requirement clarification

approvals.approved_version: Exact supplier recipient, study information disclosed, configuration question and permitted scope checked before each communication; changes void approval.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B=100, R=100, incremental=0; net=0. Standard equipment enquiries and ambiguous software configurations retain clarification time.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Register protocol patients with statistical centres

steps.what: Verify patient registration authority and capture required statistical centre fields
Populate the registration draft from verified patient and protocol fields
Register the protocol patient after final checks and retain the receipt

tasks.design: Configure permitted prefilling of a draft in {PARTNER_PORTAL} from a verified registration brief. The coordinator checks identity, enrolment authority and the completed fields before submitting and retaining the receipt in {DOCS}.
tasks.previous_blocker: Verified patient and study fields can be retyped into centre registration forms.
tasks.enabler_now: Supported native imports or prefilling can reduce duplicate entry.
tasks.still_hard: Resolve identity discrepancies, rejected registrations and centre-specific requirements.
tasks.human_edge: Recognise when the registration does not match the authorised patient and protocol.
tasks.altitude: Less duplicate entry, unchanged registration and enrolment authority.

evidence.claim: Castor Catalyst proposes case report values from source documents for human approval; this is adjacent supervised entry capability, not evidence that a statistical centre accepts automatic registrations.
Model knowledge: local registration prefilling requires a supported interface and duplicate-entry baseline; savings are unmeasured.

assumptions: Boundary is coordinator registration after an investigator's enrolment decision, excluding eligibility assessment, consent acquisition and statistical analysis. {OTHER} means clinical study records system.

The investigator produces the enrolment decision before s1. The coordinator produces patient study identifier, protocol revision, site, permitted registration data, source references and matched decision/consent evidence in s1, retaining full reading, extraction and capture time in 40%. No free eligible-for-registration flag is assumed.

s2 copies only verified s1 values through a supported native mechanism; unavailable interfaces remain manual. Receipt and rejection details arise after submission during s3 and are captured within its full time.
Test centre-native prefilling before custom code. No external action runs without coordinator approval and no new centre work is transferred.
unknowns: Centre interface support and required fields
research_questions: Does supported native prefilling remove enough retyping after authority and source checks?

already_counted.description: Final approval, submission, receipt capture and exceptions

approvals.approved_version: Exact patient study identifier, protocol, centre, submitted fields and matched enrolment/consent evidence checked before submit; changes void approval.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B=100, R=40+0+30=70; gross=30, incremental=7, net=23. Range 0-8 allows unsupported portals or existing prefilling to remove most gains; enrolment and source checking remain unchanged.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

steps.what: Solicit industry-sponsored trials through professional contacts and organizations within delegated limits

tasks.design: Keep professional outreach and trial discussions with the coordinator using {EMAIL} and current site information in {DOCS}. No automated solicitation or commitment to conduct a trial is introduced.
tasks.previous_blocker: Finding a suitable sponsored trial depends on relationships and credible discussion of site capabilities.
tasks.enabler_now: Existing professional contacts support the task; no new automation is proposed.
tasks.still_hard: Understand sponsor needs and distinguish a suitable opportunity from an unsuitable commitment.
tasks.human_edge: Build trust and know when to involve the investigator.
tasks.altitude: Outreach duties and trial acceptance authority remain unchanged.

reach.task: Explain a potential sponsored trial fit

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: professional solicitation is relationship work; no separate removable outreach-drafting baseline is established.

assumptions: Boundary is coordinator outreach and opportunity capture, excluding contract negotiation and investigator trial acceptance.

The site owner supplies approved capability information before outreach. Sponsors produce interests and requirements during s1 before opportunity qualification; the coordinator captures scope, evidence and uncertainty within its full time. No free suitable-trial flag is assumed.
Unsupported capability claims or commitments return to the site owner. Test native contact and document facilities before custom tools; none is added.
Incremental upkeep is zero because existing outreach remains unchanged and no duty is transferred.
unknowns: Outreach delegation and site capability information
research_questions: Is repeated information assembly separate from relationship building and opportunity discussion?

already_counted.description: Outreach approval, dialogue and opportunity capture

approvals.approved_version: Exact contact, proposed message, site capability statements and delegated disclosure scope checked before outreach; changes void approval.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B=100, R=100, incremental=0; net=0. Established sponsor relationships and exploratory contacts retain human outreach and qualification time.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

role.altitude: Supported registration prefilling leaves clinical advice, supplier clarification and sponsor relationships human.
reach: Explain study registration exceptions and trial fit to scientific management.
role.ambitious_version: A coordinator who can reduce verified duplicate entry while retaining clinical and relationship judgement.
